signal: Prove launched its unified Identity Platform in April 2026, positioning it as the trust layer for verifying people, businesses and AI agents in real time.

email.body1:
Danielle, saw Prove launch the Identity Platform as the trust layer for verifying people, businesses and AI agents.

A platform launch like that usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Danielle, quick follow-up for Prove.

A launch into agentic identity expands the buyers worth chasing faster than headcount can ramp, so accounts go untouched and the quarter quietly leaks pipeline. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to cover it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Danielle, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove reply rate likely compares to other identity and security platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Danielle, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a platform launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
